hints.title: Bit Position Ancestry
hints.text: At operation i, string length doubles from 2^i to 2^(i+1). If the i-th bit of k - 1 is set, the target character originated in the appended second half.

hints.title: Shift Accumulation
hints.text: When the i-th bit is set, add operations[i] to the cumulative cyclic shift from starting character 'a'.

hints.title: Logarithmic Evaluation
hints.text: Inspect each bit of k - 1 up to len(operations). Compute total shifts modulo 26 and return the corresponding character.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass inspecting up to 60 bits of index k - 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building a string of length up to 2^60 is impossible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Determines character shifts directly from the binary decomposition of k - 1.
